summary: Using Pick Block on boats crashes the game
description: I know that this is duplicated with but MAY I help you tell the reason? Description 1. Place a boat, any variant. 2. Switch to creative mode. 3. Middle-click the boat, and you ll find that it crashes. Reason "class cqh" (Boat) has a function "cvx cqh.dK()" (Boat.getPickResult). That returns a new "class cvx"(ItemStack) of function "cvt cqh.al_()" (Boat.getDropItem). "cvt cqh.al_()" (Boat.getDropItem) returns "cqh b cqh.w()" (Boat.getVariant) s "cvt cqh b.d()" (Boat Type.getBoat) . And it seemed like "cvt cqh b.d()" returns null, then "cvx. (deu, int, ku)" (ItemStack(ItemLike, int, PatchedDataComponentMap)) crashes.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Place a boat, any variant.
4. Switch to Creative mode.
5. Middle-click the boat.
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When using the Pick Block function on a boat in Minecraft, the game crashes. To reproduce this issue, one must first place a boat of any variant and then switch to creative mode. Upon middle-clicking the boat, the game encounters an error and crashes. This behavior is linked to the class cqh, which represents the Boat entity. The function cvx cqh.dK(), responsible for retrieving the pick result, attempts to create a new ItemStack using the function cvt cqh.al_(), which is associated with the boat's drop item. The drop item function retrieves the boat's variant through cqh b cqh.w() and subsequently calls cvt cqh b.d(), which is intended to return the boat type. However, in this case, cvt cqh b.d() returns null, leading to a failure when attempting to create the ItemStack using the constructor cvx. This null return value triggers a crash, as the game cannot handle the invalid state resulting from this operation.
Expected Behavior: When using the Pick Block function on a boat in Creative mode, the game should successfully create an ItemStack representing the selected boat variant without crashing. The player should be able to middle-click on the boat and receive the corresponding item in their inventory, allowing for seamless gameplay and item management. This expected behavior should occur consistently across all game versions where boats are present.
